commands: HEAD_SHA=$(gh pr view 1460 --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) && echo "head: $HEAD_SHA" && for f in skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-verdict.md; do printf '%s  ' "$f"; git show "$HEAD_SHA:$f" | python3 -c 'import sys,hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())'; done

git fetch origin 20f7254b372a1a357f67c8a72051d65efe6d2947 >/dev/null 2>&1; for f in skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-verdict.md; do printf '%s  ' "$f"; git show "20f7254b372a1a357f67c8a72051d65efe6d2947:$f" | python3 -c 'import sys,hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())'; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
git fetch -q origin pull/1460/head 2>&1 | tail -2
HEAD=20f7254b372a1a357f67c8a72051d65efe6d2947
echo "=== PR-head sha256 of the two phase files ==="
git show $HEAD:skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md | sha256sum
git show $HEAD:skills/review/phases/phase-4-verdict.md | sha256sum
echo "=== contract entries on PR head ==="
git show $HEAD:scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json | grep -E 'phase-3-agents|phase-4-verdict'

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
git fetch -q origin pull/1460/head 2>&1 | tail -1
H=20f7254b372a1a357f67c8a72051d65efe6d2947
echo "=== PR-head sha256 phase-3 ==="; git show "$H:skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md" | sha256sum
echo "=== PR-head sha256 phase-4 ==="; git show "$H:skills/review/phases/phase-4-verdict.md" | sha256sum
echo "=== contract on PR head ==="; git show "$H:scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json" | grep -E 'phase-3-agents|phase-4-verdict'

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
git fetch -q origin pull/1460/head
H=20f7254b372a1a357f67c8a72051d65efe6d2947
for f in skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-verdict.md; do
  printf '%s  ' "$f"; git show "${H}:${f}" | sha256sum
done
echo "--- contract ---"
git show "${H}:scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json" | grep -E 'phase-3-agents|phase-4-verdict'
